summary: Master climate finance proposal writing for GCF and donors. Build concept notes, budgets, and compliance-ready drafts with practical exercises.
lede: Climate finance proposal writing helps turn climate priorities into fundable concept notes and full proposals that align with Green Climate Fund and donor templates, investment criteria, and evidence requirements. This course builds practical skills in climate rationale, theory of change, results frameworks, budget logic, co-financing, fiduciary credibility, and safeguards alignment. You will practice moving a climate project from initial idea to a donor-ready package, including a concept note, financial instrument mapping, risk register, co-financing schedule, annexes, and submission checklist. The course also introduces AI-assisted evidence scanning, automated consistency checks, and digital version control to support clear, coherent drafting under tight deadlines, limited baseline data, late partner inputs, and complex review expectations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with project concepts, donor documentation, or climate funding processes and now need to strengthen proposal quality, compliance, and funder alignment.
modules: Theory of change and results frameworks
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a live or draft climate project concept, and any available baseline data, budget notes, or donor template you already use. A practical willingness to revise narrative, financial, and safeguards sections during workshop exercises will help you get the most value from the course.
